land.eyebrow: Sent from your number — not from a stranger
land.h1: Elegant digital invitations, and an entry code for every guest
land.sub: Create your event, choose a card design, add your guests. Each guest gets a personal link in their own name over WhatsApp — they confirm, pick their companions, and receive a QR code scanned at the door.
land.waMsg: We would be honoured by your presence. Your invitation:
land.howTitle: Three steps and your event is ready
land.step1b: Name, date, time and venue. Pick a template or upload your own design.
land.step2b: One at a time, or import an Excel file with the whole family in one click.
land.step3b: One button opens WhatsApp with each guest message ready. Watch confirmations arrive on your dashboard.
land.pricingTitle: Pay once per event — no monthly subscription
land.pricingSub: Priced by guest count. Every package includes entry codes, the door scanner and the post-event report.
land.faq1q: Do invitations come from my own number?
land.faq1a: Yes. We prepare a message for each guest with their name and personal link, and it opens in WhatsApp from your number with one tap — which is exactly why the open rate is so high.
land.faq2q: Does a guest need to install an app?
land.faq2a: No. The guest opens the link in their phone browser and confirms there. Their entry code appears on the same page.
land.faq3q: What if my guest count grows after I buy?
land.faq3a: You can add guests at any time, and the dashboard warns you as you approach your package limit — before you send.
land.faq4q: How does the scanner work if the venue Wi-Fi drops?
land.faq4a: The scanner opens with a password you give your door team, and they can search by name or entry code by hand if the camera will not cooperate.
land.faq5a: Your guests' numbers are yours alone. We never message them ourselves, and no other host can see them.
